title: Fox Wizard at Study
description: A white anthropomorphic fox with red and green fur sits at a wooden desk, wearing a blue bow and leafy crown while reading an open book. Above it floats a large surreal black creature with multiple clawed limbs, colorful flowers, and three glowing green eyes dripping red liquid.
prompt: Anthropomorphic white fox with red and green fur wearing a blue bow and leafy crown, sitting at an old wooden desk reading a large open book in a dark magical study, above him floats a large surreal black multi-limbed creature covered in colorful flowers and three glowing green eyes with red liquid dripping down, hanging lanterns with blue and green light, spider on the desk, red wizard hat, vines and purple flowers, dark fantasy atmosphere
